Reviewed the complete meta.validation.review_packets claim, its sole implementation entry and sole associated test, plus captured md/design/meta/validation.md and md/design/meta/reviews.md context. This is acceptance of explicit deferred evidence, not a claim that review packets are implemented or verified.

The contract requires one semantic target to connect seven elements: (1) Rust input and target, (2) readable semantic result, (3) diagnostic or completeness outcome, (4) both cold and warm dependencies, (5) relevant or unrelated edit behavior, (6) focused tests or oracle verification, and (7) anchored implementation entry points. Every designated packet must contain or link these elements, and recorded reproduction commands must regenerate the checked-in artifacts without unrecorded setup. The disjunctions permit either relevant or unrelated edit evidence, either focused or oracle evidence, and either diagnostics or completeness reporting; they do not waive the cold-and-warm requirement or reproduction requirement. Surrounding specification allows artifacts to expose limitations rather than prove destination completeness.

The complete implementation association is the todo-module comment in crates/sage-meta/tests/service_spec.rs explicitly stating that no repository-wide check verifies all seven packet elements. It is an honest missing-implementation entry, with no ordinary or N/A entry claiming the guarantee. The neighboring workspace_actor function appears in the marker's preview but is unrelated navigation context and is not packet evidence. The complete test set consists only of sage_meta::todo::meta_validation_review_packets. Its body has no assertions and explicitly defers complete evidence for all seven elements and reproducibility without unrecorded setup. It cannot detect an omitted element, a missing cold/warm dependency artifact, an unrelated target, or an unreproducible command. These are deferred requirements, not passing behavior.

The prerequisite for replacing this implementation/test TODO is a designated-packet inventory and a repository-wide validation/reproduction mechanism that checks every listed element and replays documented commands against checked-in artifacts from recorded setup. Meaningful tests must include missing-element and unreproducible-command rejection as well as complete reproducible packets. The explicit implementation absence together with the test's complete verification-scenario TODO adequately accounts for these gaps under meta.reviews.decisions; no evidence is being downgraded or relabeled. There are no additional runtime helpers to follow in this empty TODO test. All seven packet requirements and artifact regeneration remain visibly deferred.

Commands actually executed: cargo meta review start with the captured coordinator-instructions file, and cargo meta review read for reviews.md and validation.md. No behavioral test or reproduction command was executed; running the empty placeholder would add no evidence. No Rust source, specification, test, or association edits were made.
